name: input
description: A single-line text field for free-form user input with optional label, help text, and validation state.

variants.name: Default
variants.label: default
variants.description: Outlined field with a subtle border.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label shown above the input.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint text inside the empty field.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon inside the left edge of the field.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables input and removes from tab order.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the label with an asterisk.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the error border; pair with an error message.

props.name: help
props.description: Helper or error text below the field.

a11y.detail: label is programmatically associated via for/id
help text wired with aria-describedby when invalid

slots.name: default
slots.description: Arbitrary content rendered inside the field wrapper.
